description: Subcontacts will be automatically generated when a model is zoned ( block zone generate ). For rigid blocks, it is neccessary to use this command to generate subcontacts prior to assigning joint properties. By default, the face will be triangulated to generate the minimum number of subcontacts. The number of subcontacts can be increased by using block face triangulate prior to executing this command. Crash (3DEC 9.8.54, reproduced twice, 2026-10-29): after 'block zone generate edgelength 0.5 range group ...' has marked a block deformable but left it unmeshed (it reports 'mesh generation is performed after last GEN command' and block.zone count stays 0), this command terminates the 3DEC process. Rigid-only models and fully zoned models are unaffected. The deferred state ends only when a later 'block zone generate' completes the coverage of every block (then everything is meshed and subcontacts come for free); cycling does not end it, and the engine's own hint in that state ('You may need to use ... BLOCK CONTACT GENERATE-SUBCONTACTS (for rigid blocks)') points at the crashing command. Running this command before any zoning is safe but makes the blocks permanently rigid: a later 'block zone generate' answers 'cannot change block to deformable after INSITU or face triangulation'.
